name: Nuttycombe Wisconsin Invitational
where: Madison, WI · host Wisconsin · Thomas Zimmer Championship Cross Country Course
headline: Nuttycombe: New Mexico wins the men's title
summary: New Mexico won the men's title with 59 points to Colorado's 93, with No. 7 BYU third at 146; Colorado freshman Meshack Kipruto won in a course-record 22:30.1, 0.7 seconds ahead of New Mexico's Pasanjo Kitonga. West Virginia took the women's race with 66 points to Florida's 111 and Northern Arizona's 130, and Florida's Judy Chepkoech won in 19:19.5.

insights.lede: No. 1 New Mexico won by 34 points over No. 6 Colorado, 59–93, while No. 2 Iowa State finished 19th. Colorado freshman Meshack Kipruto won in a course-record 22:30.1, and the top four men all broke the old Zimmer record of 22:33.8.
insights.dual: New Mexico went 34–0 in head-to-head scoring against the field. 38 head-to-heads go against the final team standings; the highest-placed is 5th-place Florida beating 4th-place Arkansas 28–28 on the sixth-runner tiebreak.
insights.next: Take out the seniors and BYU wins this race with 119 points. New Mexico loses one of its five scorers and would be second with 127.
notes: New Mexico was 2nd at 2K, took the lead at 4K and never gave it back. Colorado led at 2K and finished 2nd.
Kipruto ran the fastest 6K-to-finish split in the field, 5:35.0. Louisville's Elsingi Kipruto was next at 5:35.8 on his way to 3rd.

insights.lede: West Virginia won with 66 points to Florida's 111 and Northern Arizona's 130, a result that moved the Mountaineers from 9th to 3rd in the next poll. Florida's Judy Chepkoech won in 19:19.5.
